title: linanthus pungens subsp. hazeliae
intro: Linanthus pungens subsp. hazeliae, commonly known as Hazelia's linanthus, is a species of flowering plant in the Polemoniaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Linanthus pungens subsp. hazeliae include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
